candidates.change_summary: Remove the minimum deposit condition so that any msg.value, even below MinDeposit, is accepted.
Replace the safe-math overflow check with a tautology so that overflow can occur for huge balances.
Delete the safe-math require check entirely, allowing unchecked addition that can overflow.
Add msg.value to an address other than the caller (msg.sender) so the caller's balance is unchanged but another is credited.
Replace the addition assignment with a plain assignment, overwriting the balance to msg.value instead of accumulating.
Insert a statement that adds 1 wei to the balance after the normal deposit, changing the final balance.
